name: PRIME MD
description: PRIME MD - powerful multi-session WhatsApp mini bot by AR Samoon

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB connection string for sessions and settings. Leave unset/placeholder to run on local file auth.

SERVER_ID.description: Numeric ID of this server instance. Each instance restores only its own sessions.

SESSION_LIMIT.description: Maximum number of paired sessions on this server.

PAIR_CODE.description: Custom 8-character pairing code word tried first (random code is the silent fallback).

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Global owner WhatsApp number (digits, with country code). Always allowed, even in private mode.

ADMIN_PASS.description: Password for the /admin web panel. Leave unset to keep the panel disabled - there is no default password.
